speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether there are plans to (i) improve and enhance job-readiness and training in our Day Activity Centres (DACs) for young adults with special needs beyond 18 years old, such as collaborating with our ITEs for such training and (ii) provide more funding support and resources to ensure full placement of such young adults from Mondays to Fridays.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: These centres aim to equip persons with disabilities with community and daily living skills so as to enable them to live as independently as possible at home and also within the community.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: DAC participants who show progress and proficiency in these skills can be considered for entry into Sheltered Workshops.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: DACs are open from Mondays to Fridays to serve eligible persons with disabilities who wish to participate in their activities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: Sheltered Workshops collaborate with industry partners to develop training programmes for their participants.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: Like DACs, Sheltered Workshops also provide services from Mondays to Fridays for those who are able to participate.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: In addition to all these, adults with disabilities looking for employment can tap on the programmes under the Ministry of Manpower's (MOM’s) Adapt and Grow initiatives, such as the Open Door Programme and Career Trial.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: The Open Door Programme, which is administered by SG Enable, provides job placement and job support services, as well as grants for training and job redesign.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: Career Trial provides an opportunity for jobseekers and employers to assess job fit through a work trial.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: During the trial, which can be up to three months, jobseekers receive a training allowance from the Government.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: For those who are above 67, they will get 22% of the SEC.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
text: In addition, SG Enable also helps to prepare persons with disabilities through curriculum vitae clinics and the RISE Mentorship and institute of higher learning (IHL) Internship programmes.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Lately, I have had the opportunity to meet up with parents of children with special needs.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: And the common refrain among them, especially those whose children are 18 years old and above, is that they are not able to get full placement for their children in the DACs, that means, from Monday to Friday.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: More often than not, it is always two to three days a week, and then what happens for the remaining two or three other days?

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: It means they have to take leave to take care of their children.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I am just wondering whether MSF would have plans to coordinate better among the DACS and the Sheltered Workshops with oversight from MSF so that the parents can be assured of full placement for their older children from Mondays to Fridays.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Another supplementary question, Mr Speaker, is that whether there are plans to have a more integrated approach for education and training for children with special needs, starting from preschool all the way to work-readiness training that can be overseen by a few Ministries – MSF, the Ministry of Education (MOE) and MOM – together.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: For those who are not able to attend full-time from Mondays to Fridays, if the Member comes across any specific cases, please let us know so that we can get our social service agencies and my Ministry staff to look into such cases to better understand the reason why they are not able to take full advantage of the services provided by the DACs and Sheltered Workshops from Monday to Friday.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: As to the Member's second question about the more concerted and integrated approach, this is, indeed, something that we are doing.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: We share the same concerns as the Member.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: One of the workgroups is focusing on early intervention programmes.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: This workgroup is co-chaired by my colleagues Senior Parliamentary Secretary Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim together with Assoc Prof Kenneth Poon.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: So, they are looking into how to strengthen the learning support and the development support programmes in our preschool education centres serving students with special needs and disabilities.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: One of the things they are doing is to strengthen the learning of the life skills and also other social skills.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: These are the important attributes and skills that will better prepare our students when they grow into adults and these attributes will enable them to integrate more smoothly into the society.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: This workgroup is co-chaired by Member Ms Denise Phua and myself.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: This workgroup focuses specifically on how we can encourage more enlightened employers to provide employment opportunities for persons with disabilities.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: At the same time, we are also looking into how we can further strengthen and improve the training programmes for persons with disabilities and special needs, so that they will be able to grab the opportunities to be able to get employed.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: So, there is a slew of initiatives and programmes under MSF, SG Enable.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: We also partner MOE as well as MOM.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: So, there is a concerted effort aimed at trying to help persons with disabilities to better integrate into our society through employment.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Please keep your question short, and I would like an answer that is short as well.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: I also similarly have residents who share with me the challenges that their special needs children face when they reach the age of 18.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: If there is a need for more capacity, we will certainly increase it.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: With regard to the Member's resident, I would appreciate it if she can provide the details to me, and we will follow up and try our best to help him or her to get into one of the Sheltered Workshops.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Ministerial Statement on behalf of the Minister for Transport.
